handoff.summary: Implemented src/lifecycle/retain.ts (label-scoped two-image retention with in-use, shared, foreign-label, removal-failure, missing-image, and already-clean handling) and wired it into post-success update and rollback with warning-only failures and unchanged phase order. Added 23 retain tests plus update/rollback wiring tests; typecheck, lint, build, the focused suites, and the full 763-test suite pass. A real Podman 5.7.0 smoke of the default image store passed.
decisions: Keep set = recorded current/previous + images used by running containers + references in any other app's recorded pair; everything else labelled for the app is removed.

Every candidate is re-checked against its own io.easy-host.app label before removal; unlabelled or foreign-labelled images are reported and never removed, so tag patterns alone can never authorize a delete.
If any sibling app's state.json cannot be read, sharing cannot be ruled out, so no candidate is removed and each is reported as unverified-shared.
A failed per-image removal is a warning and retention continues; a failed listing raises PrerequisiteError because no safe decision can be made.
Missing recorded references are reported in the result; the warning is suppressed when the app has no labelled images at all, since that means there is nothing retention could have removed.

Retention runs after a successful config-only/rebuild/first-start update and after a healthy rollback, with the operation's registry, state cache, and environment; it never runs for a no-op, failed build, or reverted swap, and a retention failure never changes the command's exit code.
Retention phases are narrated as informational lines so update/rollback phase arrays and command output contracts stay unchanged.
interfaces: RetainRequest, RetainDependencies, RetainDependencyOverrides, RetainResult, RetainedImage, RefusedImage, RetainImageStore, RetainedImageEntry, RetainImages
warnings: Railpack-built images do not yet carry the io.easy-host.app label, so the label-filtered listing finds no candidates on a real host until the build layer labels images; retention deliberately does not fall back to tag matching (task constraint). This needs a build-engineer interface change.

src/platform/podman.ts has no image operations, so list/remove are implemented in retain.ts through the shared PodmanRunner; platform-engineer should absorb listImages/removeImage into the platform adapter without changing RetainImageStore.
The retention pass means every successful update/rollback now runs `podman images --filter label=...` and `podman ps`; both are bounded at 60s and their failure is a warning.
validationLimitations: No gated EASY_HOST_INTEGRATION suite was run; RBK-1.2's declared checks are unit-level, and the gated update/rollback suites (UPD-1.4, RBK-1.4) are qa-engineer-owned.
Real image removal was not exercised end to end because the host has no easy-host-labelled images; the real adapter's list and idempotent-remove paths were smoke-tested against Podman 5.7.0.
